en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a naval destroyer steaming at sea, with smoke coming from multiple funnels and sailors visible on deck. A smaller group of warships appears on the horizon to the right. The sea is choppy and the sky is cloudy. There is printed text at the bottom identifying the ship as 'Jagaren Wale.' and publisher information at the lower right. An artist's signature and date appear at the lower left.
